messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-18]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder on 2025-09-16; Cinder owns it as of that date. [decision; valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the authentication gateway. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-09-16; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date. [decision; valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-07-17 to 2025-10-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-17]
    earlier: The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-07-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- During INC-2026-003, the webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- During INC-2026-009, the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03 during incident INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team; ownership transferred from the Ember team on that date, and the Dune team never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Dune team; ownership transferred from the Ember team on that date. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-06, the feature-flags service is owned by the Ember team; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11; recorded by handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- Follow-up decision from the INC-2026-003 review: the webhook dispatcher will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [decision; valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2025-07-17, Yuki Tanaka handed the Cinder pager to Diego on rotation day. [valid 2025-07-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-17]
